test_title: PYST 2: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

I totally disagree with his ______ proposal as he has not weighed the pros and cons.
solution:
The correct answer is '**ridiculous**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**ridiculous**'.
 
• It means **'very silly or unreasonable'.** (मूखर्तापूर्ण या बेतुका)
 
 
• *Example: They’re asking a **ridiculous** price for that house.*
 
 
 
• A negative word will be used as the sentence mentions that the person had not calculated the advantages and disadvantages.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *I totally disagree with his __**ridiculous**__ proposal as he has not weighed the pros and cons.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **realistic**: having or showing a sensible and practical idea of what can be achieved or expected. (क्या हासिल किया जा सकता है या क्या उम्मीद की जा सकती है, इसका एक समझदार और व्यावहारिक विचार होना या दिखाना)
 
• **rational**: (used about a person) able to use logical thought rather than emotions to make decisions. [(व्‍यक्ति) विवेकशील; समझदार (निर्णय करने में भावनाओं के स्‍थान पर तर्कबुद्धि का प्रयोग करने वाला)]
 
• **conceivable**: possible to imagine or believe. (कल्‍पनीय, विश्‍वास योग्‍य)
 
 

3f:Tc50,

The correct answer is '**Conclude**'.
